description: TXPOST: POST TRANSACTIONS TO THE ACCOUNT MASTER
MATCHES THE SORTED TRANSACTIONS AGAINST THE OLD MASTER, BOTH
IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER, AND WRITES THE NEW MASTER: EVERY OLD
RECORD, WITH ITS TRANSACTIONS APPLIED. EACH POSTING GOES TO
THE AUDIT TRAIL; A TRANSACTION THAT CANNOT BE POSTED GOES TO
THE REJECTS. BOTH ARE APPENDED TO, AS THE DAILY BATCH RUNS
TXPOST FOUR TIMES:
0. THE MONTH-END INTEREST AND FEES FROM MONCHG, ON THE DAY
A MONTH CLOSES; ON OTHER DAYS NONE.
1. THE DAY'S TRANSACTIONS. A POSTED TRANSFER WRITES A
TRANSFER CREDIT FOR THE RECEIVING ACCOUNT TO THE LEGS.
2. THE TRANSFER CREDITS, SORTED. ONE FOR AN UNKNOWN OR
CLOSED ACCOUNT WRITES A RETURNED TRANSFER TO THE LEGS.
3. THE RETURNED TRANSFERS, SORTED.
RULES: NOTHING POSTS TO A CLOSED ACCOUNT. CREDITS AND FEES
POST TO A FROZEN ACCOUNT, WITHDRAWALS AND TRANSFERS DO NOT. A
DEBIT MAY TAKE THE BALANCE DOWN TO THE OVERDRAFT LIMIT, NO
FURTHER. A FEE ALWAYS POSTS, EVEN PAST THE LIMIT. INTEREST
POSTS AS A CREDIT, OVERDRAFT INTEREST AND MAINTENANCE FEES AS
FEES.
RETURN CODES: 0 ALL POSTED, 4 SOME REJECTED,
16 INPUT OUT OF ORDER, OUT OF BALANCE OR I/O.

identification.text: FIRST BANK OF PANGAEA, DATA CENTER.

records.name: BANK-CONTROL-RECORD
records.description: BANKCTL: BANK CONTROL RECORD, ONE PER FILE THE BUSINESS DATE THE BATCH RUNS FOR, NEVER THE CLOCK.

records.name: ACCT-MASTER-RECORD
records.description: ACCTMAST: ACCOUNT MASTER RECORD, 100 BYTES IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER. THE BALANCE MAY GO BELOW ZERO DOWN TO THE OVERDRAFT LIMIT, AND BELOW THAT ONLY BY FEES. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1987-03-12 JA  ORIGINAL VERSION. 1994-11-14 PK  CR-0201 OVERDRAFT LIMIT, FROM THE FILLER. 1999-01-11 SL  Y2K: 8-DIGIT DATES.

records.name: TRAN-RECORD
records.description: TRANREC: DAILY TRANSACTION FILE RECORD, 80 BYTES ONE HEADER, THE DETAILS, ONE TRAILER, TOLD APART BY THE RECORD TYPE. THE BODY IS REDEFINED FOR EACH RECORD TYPE. THE TRAILER CARRIES THE SENDER'S CONTROL TOTALS: THE DETAIL COUNT, THE SUM OF AMOUNTS AND THE SUM OF ACCOUNT NUMBERS. A TRANSFER (TR) NAMES THE ACCOUNT IT GOES TO. POSTING SPLITS IT IN TWO: THE DEBIT ON THE SENDING ACCOUNT, THEN A TRANSFER CREDIT (TC) ON THE RECEIVING ONE. A CREDIT THAT CANNOT POST GOES BACK AS A RETURNED TRANSFER (RT). TC AND RT ARE MADE BY POSTING, NEVER RECEIVED IN THE DAILY FILE. WHEN A MONTH CLOSES, THE BANK CREDITS ITS INTEREST (IN), CHARGES OVERDRAFT INTEREST (OD) AND THE MAINTENANCE FEE (MF). THESE TOO ARE NEVER RECEIVED IN THE DAILY FILE. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1987-03-12 JA  ORIGINAL VERSION. 1991-06-03 PK  CR-0117 ACCOUNT NUMBER HASH IN THE TRAILER. 1996-04-15 PK  CR-0233 TRANSFERS: COUNTER ACCOUNT, FROM THE FILLER. 2001-09-03 TL  CR-0298 MONTH-END INTEREST AND FEE CODES.

records.name: WS-MASTER-KEY
records.description: MATCH KEYS: HIGH-VALUES ONCE A FILE IS AT ITS END.

records.name: WS-SAVED-TRAN
records.description: A LEG IS WRITTEN FROM THE TRANSACTION RECORD ITSELF, TURNED AROUND; THE TRANSACTION IS SAVED HERE AND PUT BACK AFTER.

records.name: AUDIT-RECORD
records.description: AUDITREC: AUDIT TRAIL RECORD, 100 BYTES, ONE PER POSTING THE AMOUNT IS SIGNED: CREDITS POSITIVE, DEBITS NEGATIVE.

records.name: REJECT-RECORD
records.description: REJREC: REJECTED TRANSACTION, 100 BYTES THE TRANSACTION AS RECEIVED, WITH THE STEP THAT REJECTED IT AND WHY.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.description: MATCH UNTIL BOTH FILES END, THEN RECONCILE AND REPORT.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.description: OPEN THE FILES AND READ THE FIRST RECORD OF EACH. THE AUDIT TRAIL AND THE REJECTS ARE EXTENDED, AND CREATED IF NEW.

paragraphs.name: 1200-READ-MASTER
paragraphs.description: READ THE NEXT OLD MASTER RECORD, CHECKING ACCOUNT ORDER.

paragraphs.name: 1300-READ-TRAN
paragraphs.description: READ THE NEXT TRANSACTION, CHECKING ITS ORDER.

paragraphs.name: 2000-MATCH
paragraphs.description: ONE STEP OF THE MATCH, BY WHICHEVER KEY IS LOWER: REJECT A TRANSACTION FOR A MISSING ACCOUNT, APPLY ONE TO ITS ACCOUNT, OR WRITE A FINISHED ACCOUNT.

paragraphs.name: 3000-APPLY-TRAN
paragraphs.description: APPLY ONE TRANSACTION TO ITS ACCOUNT BY THE POSTING RULES.

paragraphs.name: 3100-POST-CREDIT
paragraphs.description: CREDIT A DEPOSIT, A TRANSFER CREDIT, A RETURNED TRANSFER OR INTEREST.

paragraphs.name: 3200-POST-DEBIT
paragraphs.description: DEBIT A WITHDRAWAL OR TRANSFER IF IT STAYS WITHIN THE OVERDRAFT LIMIT. A POSTED TRANSFER SENDS ITS CREDIT ON.

paragraphs.name: 3300-POST-FEE
paragraphs.description: DEBIT A FEE, OVERDRAFT INTEREST OR A MAINTENANCE FEE, WHATEVER THE BALANCE.

paragraphs.name: 3500-WRITE-LEG
paragraphs.description: WRITE THE NEXT LEG OF A TRANSFER FOR THE COUNTER ACCOUNT: A TRANSFER CREDIT AFTER A TRANSFER, A RETURN AFTER A CREDIT THAT COULD NOT POST.

paragraphs.name: 3800-WRITE-AUDIT
paragraphs.description: RECORD A POSTING IN THE AUDIT TRAIL.

paragraphs.name: 3900-REJECT-TRAN
paragraphs.description: WRITE THE TRANSACTION TO THE REJECTS WITH ITS REASON. A TRANSFER CREDIT THAT CANNOT POST GOES BACK TO ITS SENDER.

paragraphs.name: 4000-WRITE-MASTER
paragraphs.description: WRITE AN ACCOUNT, ITS TRANSACTIONS APPLIED, TO THE NEW MASTER.

paragraphs.name: 5000-RECONCILE
paragraphs.description: THE NEW MASTER MUST HOLD THE OLD BALANCES PLUS WHAT WAS POSTED.

paragraphs.name: 9900-ABORT
paragraphs.description: STOP THE RUN WITH RETURN CODE 16, SAYING WHY.
